name: understand-intent
description: Universal skill for AI models and agents to decode the user's true underlying intent, unstated goals, and creative vision across any domain—including teaching and education, office and administrative work, design and creative projects, documents, forms, images/sketches, and coding.
author: VoxCode.app
triggers: User provides brief, terse, or informal request on existing materials
Analyzing images, sketches, handwritten notes, forms, or worksheets
Teacher planning lessons, curriculum, activities, or student evaluations
Completing, updating, or expanding office documents, spreadsheets, or memos
Creative writing, marketing, or design drafts with established tone
Refactoring or completing code without imposing generic paradigms
